params.instruction:
Reconstruct the figure in TikZ. Image pixel coords (origin top-left, y down); flip y when writing TikZ. Use a scale such as 1 unit = 1/100 of ~pixel scale, or just use pixel/100 cm and flip y as (x/100, (488-y)/100).
Centre O = (239.0, 261.7). Circumcircle: centre O, radius 196.6 px, full circle (solid). Incircle: centre O, radius 98.9 px, full circle (solid).
Triangle ABC (solid edges, inscribed in circumcircle, isosceles/equilateral-looking):
A = (239.0, 59.0) (top, on circumcircle), B = (68.3, 359.6), C = (409.0, 360.0).
Side BC is horizontal at y=360 and is tangent to the incircle at D = (239.0, 360.0). Draw BC through D.
Points E = (330.4, 223.7) (tangency on AC) and F = (153.6, 212.3) (tangency on AB) lie on the incircle. Draw edges AB and AC as straight segments, passing through F and E respectively.
Draw segment A--O (vertical solid line from (239,59) to O) and segment O--F (solid line from O to F).
Labels (verified in original image): A above top vertex; B lower-left of B vertex; C lower-right of C vertex; D below D; E to the upper-right of E; F to the left of F; O to the lower-right of O centre. Place labels just outside the points with small offsets. No dashed lines; no right-angle marks needed. Use named coordinates for shared vertices (define each point once and reuse). Keep the drawing compilable with standard tikz only.
